text:
The goal triangulates to about (-0.023, 0.882, 0.179) with 0.4 px reprojection error. From the corner view, the red puck projects to roughly (-0.01, 0.68, 0.02) on the table plane. I'll move above the puck with the gripper open and the initial orientation held, then check the result.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.010, 0.684, 0.12, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0], "gripper": 1.0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand reached the pre-grasp pose (position error 1.7 cm, orientation error 0.03 rad). Next I'll descend toward the puck with the gripper still open, then check the image.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "precision", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.010, 0.684, 0.03, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0], "gripper": 1.0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand is descending (z ≈ 0.070) but hit the 24-step limit before arriving. I'll continue the descent toward z = 0.03 with the gripper still open.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "precision", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.010, 0.684, 0.03, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0], "gripper": 1.0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The descent stalled at z ≈ 0.047 with the gripper open. Before forcing further motion, I'll capture the top view to see whether the fingers are blocked by the puck or are misaligned with it.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["topview", "corner"]}}]}
```

The top view shows the gripper head over the puck's expected location, so the puck is hidden beneath the hand. The stall at z ≈ 0.047 probably means the fingers are resting on the puck or its edge. I'll back off upward to z = 0.10 to clear it and get a clearer view before retrying.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.008, 0.678, 0.10, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0], "gripper": 1.0}], "max_steps": 12}}]}
```

The gripper now sits at z ≈ 0.083 and covers the puck's earlier corner-view location, so I can't tell whether the puck is still there or was pushed. I'll move the hand aside and up to clear the view, then recapture both cameras to relocate the puck.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [0.02, 0.56, 0.16, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0], "gripper": 1.0}], "max_steps": 16}}, {"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The corner view shows the red puck still at its original pixel location (~159,127), so it hasn't been displaced. The topview is occluded by the wrist there, so I'll rely on the calibrated corner estimate (about -0.010, 0.684, 0.02). The earlier stall at z ≈ 0.047 may be a reach or contact limit. I'll return to the pre-grasp height above the puck, then test a slightly higher grasp height.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.010, 0.684, 0.10, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0], "gripper": 1.0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand is at about (-0.008, 0.674, 0.095) and the puck is just below the finger tips in the corner view. I'll descend at the same x/y to z = 0.05 with the gripper open and check whether the pose is reached.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.010, 0.684, 0.05, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0], "gripper": 1.0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The arm is at z ≈ 0.067 with the gripper open, and the puck is now hidden behind the finger tips. I'll close the gripper here and check whether the puck is held.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "grasp", "arguments": {"targets": [{"arm": "arm"}], "steps": 8}}]}
```

The gripper stopped at 0.70 normalized opening while commanded to 0, so the fingers were likely blocked by the puck. I'll lift a short distance (without changing the grip command) and check whether the puck rises with the hand.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.008, 0.677, 0.14, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0]}], "max_steps": 16}}]}
```

The hand rose to z ≈ 0.124, but the gripper is still closing (0.47 opening), and the red puck is no longer visible at its original spot in the corner view. I need to confirm whether the puck is held before moving, so I'll capture both cameras.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

Neither camera shows the puck clearly, so attachment is still unverified. The task's next step is to carry the puck to the goal, so I'll move toward the goal with the grip command unchanged and check whether the puck travels with the hand.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.023, 0.882, 0.18, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0]}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand is now at (-0.018, 0.776, 0.157), still short of the goal and with no puck visible in the corner view. I'll continue to the goal and check whether the puck appears there.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.023, 0.882, 0.18, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0]}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand is at (-0.020, 0.826, 0.177), still moving toward the goal, and no puck is visible in the corner view. I'll check the top view for the puck's location before continuing.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["topview", "corner"]}}]}
```

The top view shows the goal marker partly covered by the hand. The corner view no longer shows the puck at its original spot, but I can't tell whether it is still held. I'll move the hand clear of the table area to get an unobstructed view.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "approach", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [0.08, 0.60, 0.20, 0.0, 1.5758, 0.0]}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```
